exposure: subscale Satisfaction with Delivery from the Childbirth Perception Questionnaire
cohort: A convenient online sample of 552 women who completed questionnaires in the first year postpartum.
finding: The Croatian version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale-Revised was found to be valid and reliable, with both a three-factor and two-factor model showing excellent fit, and a three-factor model suggested as the better conceptualization.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by unassisted vaginal birth and planned caesarean section reported higher levels of birth satisfaction.
